name: interrupt-hook
description: Runs your command when you press Escape to interrupt Claude Code mid-turn, with a JSON line on stdin like a hook's. Claude Code's Stop hook skips interrupts.

command.title: Command
command.description: Shell command to run when you interrupt a turn. It reads one JSON line on stdin: hook_event_name, session_id, cwd, turn_id, duration_ms. Left empty, nothing runs.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long the command may run, 1 to 600 seconds.
